records.text: Hamas has no control in the West Bank, where 37 Palestinian children had been killed through August and 7,000 Palestinians had been killed since the occupation.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: Hamas has absolutely no control in the West Bank and this is the beginning of this street. ... Only through August, ... 37 Palestinian kids were killed. ... No music festival, ... no paragliding, ... no Hamas. Since the occupation of the West Bank, ... 7,000 Palestinians were killed.

verification.notes: The Palestinian Authority, not Hamas, administers parts of the West Bank, though Hamas maintains political and militant presence there. A contemporaneous child-rights report counted 37 Palestinian children killed across the occupied Palestinian territory by early August 2023, not solely the West Bank; the asserted 7,000-since-occupation total was not substantiated.

sources.relevance: Confirms the 37-child figure while showing it covered the occupied Palestinian territory, including Gaza, rather than only the West Bank.

records.text: Miriam Adelson wanted Donald Trump, in exchange for $100 million, to allow annexation of the West Bank.
records.speaker: Miriam Adelson

appearances.snippet: What Charlie (Charlie Kirk) and Andrew Kolvet told me was that she said that she wanted, in exchange, for Trump to allow them to annex not Gaza, but the West Bank.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Federal Election Commission records and Times of Israel reporting confirm that Miriam Adelson backed a pro-Trump PAC with approximately 100 million dollars, and reporting links her advocacy to West Bank annexation. Her spokesperson denied that support was conditioned on annexation, and no public agreement proves an explicit quid pro quo. The amount and policy preference are supported; the in-exchange-for formulation is not established.

records.text: Bassem Youssef said Breaking the Silence is a group of former IDF soldiers who describe atrocities and behind-the-scenes operations in Gaza and the West Bank.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: breaking the silence which is like the group of the idf soldiers who they have a movement called breaking the silence ex-idf soldiers who speaks about the atrocities that they did and then now they come up and and saying like what what happened behind the scenes of their operations in Gaza and West Bank

verification.notes: Breaking the Silence describes itself as an organization of veteran Israeli soldiers that publishes researched testimonies about military service and firsthand actions in the West Bank, Gaza, and East Jerusalem. Its materials discuss abuse, destruction, violence, orders, and operations. That confirms the group's identity and core activity; 'atrocities that they did' is Youssef's broader characterization rather than the organization's uniform description of every testimony.
